messages.text: Hotel is okay? Eat something hot, not only chai.
Veg-only aunty? Good. At least someone will make you eat.
Sleep early. Iron your clothes for Monday.
Own room? Send photo. Lock the door at night, and buy a bed before a TV.
Sunday? Go somewhere green. Don't sit with the phone the whole day.
Did you reach home? The news is saying something about Bangalore. Reply.
Where are you? Your phone rang and rang. Call me.
